title: The Legend of the Golden King
description: An educational and immersive journey through the Puranic history of Lord Garuda, explaining his divine origin and power.

scenes.visual_prompt: A giant, glowing golden egg cracking open amidst a cosmic void. Intense light spills out, taking the shape of a massive bird. Mythical Vedic art style, swirling nebulae, high-contrast gold and deep purple. Cinematic sparkles and divine particles.
scenes.motion_prompt: Camera pushes in slowly as the egg cracks, followed by a sudden burst of golden light expanding outward.
scenes.narration: Long before the oceans were calmed, a power was born that shook the heavens. This is the story of Garuda.

scenes.visual_prompt: Extreme close-up and pan of Lord Garuda's form. A fierce white eagle face with a sharp golden beak, emerald-colored eyes, and a muscular human-like torso. He wears a crown of sun-fire and serpents draped like jewelry over his shoulders. His wings span the horizon, shimmering like molten copper. High-fidelity mythological fantasy.
scenes.motion_prompt: Slow cinematic pan from his powerful talons up to his majestic crowned head.
scenes.narration: Half-man, half-eagle, his body glowed with the brilliance of a thousand suns. To look at him was to see the fire of the cosmos itself.

scenes.visual_prompt: Garuda soaring upward, leaving the Earth behind. He passes through the clouds and into a realm of floating Vedic citadels. Lightning strikes his wings but he absorbs the energy. He is carrying a mountain in one claw, showcasing his immense strength. Epic scale, cinematic wide shot, rich textures.
scenes.motion_prompt: Follow shot from behind Garuda as he accelerates through layers of clouds, creating a sonic boom effect in the mist.
scenes.narration: He flew higher than any god dared, driven by a sacred vow to free his mother. In his flight, fear died, and legend was born.

scenes.visual_prompt: Garuda bowing before a radiant blue light—Lord Vishnu. The two merge into a symbolic icon of the 'Vahana'. The background is a golden mandala of the universe. Garuda’s wings are spread wide, now calm and protective. Surreal, spiritual, ending on a masterpiece visual of the Garuda-Stambha pillar silhouette.
scenes.motion_prompt: Slow zoom out to reveal the grand scale of the divine meeting, everything bathed in a warm, eternal glow.
scenes.narration: Today, we see him as the king of birds. But he is more—he is the reminder that when you rise for a higher purpose, you become unstoppable.
